title: Allow users to disable announcements: OFF, notification still contains info how to disable it
body:
Hi all!

I noticed that even when the setting:

Admin > Configuration > General > Allow users to disable announcements

is unchecked (set to OFF), at the bottom of notification email users still see this message:

> To unsubscribe from these announcements, login to the forum and uncheck "Receive forum announcements and important notifications by email." in your profile.

Because users cannot change this setting (as it was disabled via Admin) this part of notification should be removed.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Another discussion could be if this practice of disallowing users to disable Admin notifications does not brake any current or future privacy related law.
